description: The unchanged upstream API preserves its stated key validation and JSON responses.
An invalid key still gets401 but the error says permission granted; the original suite checks status only and misses this response regression.
A seeded middleware change accepts an invalid nonempty key; ordinary upstream tests should detect this too.
Restore the exact upstream error text while preserving valid responses and missing-key handling.
Renaming the local API-key variable leaves all observed HTTP behavior intact.
Removing input trimming violates the separately published TodoMVC app-spec; reducer smoke tests do not exercise the input component.
Trimming ASCII spaces alone leaves tab padding; the app specification requires JavaScript trim semantics.
Restore the unmodified upstream input component and preserve creating a plain todo.
A callback identifier rename must not be treated as a behavioral defect.
A deliberately overconfident approval maps the trimming objective only to a heading check; scoped evidence passes while the real trim defect remains.
A correct implementation cannot complete an objective whose criterion coverage has not been confirmed.
The approved command exits before readiness; old passing tests cannot establish application success.
